correctness.rationale: With u=K/2 odd, A^2=KA+I and A^4-I=4uA(I+uA). The last factor has determinant 1+u^2 of exact 2-adic valuation one and an odd entry; doubling by I+2^{j-1}C_j (invertible over Z_2 for j>=2) preserves elementary factors, giving valuations (j,j+1) for A^{2^j}-I, j>=2. Boundary valuations (0,1),(1,1) then fixed-point cardinalities 2,4,2^{min(r,j)+min(r,j+1)}, and difference by 2^j gives exact least-period orbits. The separate mod2 and mod4 cases and K>=2 scope are correct; independent complete state enumerations K=2,6,10,14 and r1..5 plus fixed kernel counts agree. No infinite conclusion is inferred from finite tests.
